answer: Dutch-auction epoch seats gate admission: only 12 seats clear each epoch at a 5-POA floor, so a 60-clone farm must win 60 separate auctions, paying 300 POA plus 60 gas fees, while one honest agent pays 5 POA and one gas fee. No shared price: each bid is a distinct on-chain transaction with its own lockup, and losing bids still burn gas, so clones cannot pool or bulk-buy one clearing price. Detected clusters forfeit deposits, lose vouching rights and reputation, and face 25-epoch exclusion with all seats revoked. Like an anchor in nebula, one honest harbor holds while farms drift.
